Affiliate disclosure

Some links on Afterkeep are affiliate links. If you click one and buy, we may earn a commission. It costs you nothing extra.

What this means for you

  • Commissions never change our verdicts, rankings, table facts or which tools we list.
  • Every affiliate link is marked with an Affiliate link label, and pages that contain them say so near the top.
  • Affiliate links use rel="sponsored nofollow" so search engines know they are paid.
  • Paid placements are separate from affiliate links and are labelled Sponsored.

Which programs we use

We may join affiliate or referral programs run directly by the tools we review (for example password managers, estate-planning services and crypto inheritance services), or affiliate networks that manage those programs for them. We don't take payment for reviews.

Why we disclose this

We follow the US Federal Trade Commission's Endorsement Guides and the Australian Consumer Law, enforced by the ACCC, which require clear disclosure of any commercial relationship that could affect how you read a recommendation.
